description: Miovision Traffic Volume Data (All) is a dataset listed in City of Cambridge open data portal (data.cambridgema.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Cambridge. Traffic data comes from sensors installed at city intersections. These sensors do not take video of traffic, but instead determine by size whether each passing vehicle is a car, truck, bike, van, etc. The table below shows traffic at each intersection in 15-minute increments. Coverage: Cambridge, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are street intersections, bicycle count, street lights, streets, traffic counts. The table has 8 columns. Attribution on the portal: Miovision. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cambridgema-gov-portal.
